description: This file defines the IQueueAdapter interface and extension methods for queue adapters in Orleans streaming, including methods for sending message batches, creating receivers, and properties indicating stream capabilities.

classes.name: IQueueAdapter
classes.description: An abstraction layer for stream queue storage adapters, providing methods to send message batches, create receivers, and properties indicating stream capabilities.

classes.name: QueueAdapterExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for IQueueAdapter, such as QueueMessageAsync for sending individual events as batch.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Sends a batch of events to the queue associated with a specific stream ID.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a queue receiver for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageAsync
methods.description: Extension method that sends a single event as a batch to the queue.
